---
title: "Start by writing it down"
date: 2026-09-01
description: "Why the first data project for a small business is usually just recording something consistently."
---

SAMPLE POST — replace before launching the blog.

The most useful first step for a lot of small businesses isn't a dashboard. It's picking one thing that matters — jobs booked, enquiries received, stock sold — and writing it down the same way every time.

Three months of a consistent record will answer questions that years of memory can't.
